i_want: to scan a QR code on a machine and pay for a cycle using my phone
so_that: I can start my laundry quickly without needing cash or coins.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am a customer at a laundromat and have the SpinCycle app open
acceptance_criteria.when: I scan the QR code on an available machine and select a cycle type (e.g., 'Normal Wash')
acceptance_criteria.then: I am presented with the payment screen for that cycle.

acceptance_criteria.given: I have selected a cycle and am on the payment screen
acceptance_criteria.when: I confirm payment with a valid payment method
acceptance_criteria.then: the machine physically starts its cycle within 5 seconds of the confirmation.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am a new user without the app installed
acceptance_criteria.when: I scan a machine's QR code with my phone's camera
acceptance_criteria.then: my browser opens the Progressive Web App (PWA) where I can complete the payment as a guest.

edge_cases: The QR code is damaged or unreadable.
The selected machine is in 'out-of-order' or 'running' status.
The payment method is declined by the payment gateway.
Network connectivity is lost between payment confirmation and the machine start command.

i_want: to see a real-time map of the laundromat showing machine availability
so_that: I can quickly find an open machine without walking around.

acceptance_criteria.given: I have the app open and select a laundromat location
acceptance_criteria.when: I view the machine map
acceptance_criteria.then: all available machines are shown in green.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am viewing the machine map
acceptance_criteria.when: a machine is in an active cycle
acceptance_criteria.then: it is shown in yellow.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am viewing the machine map
acceptance_criteria.when: a machine is marked as out of order
acceptance_criteria.then: it is shown in red.

acceptance_criteria.given: a machine's status changes (e.g., from 'running' to 'idle')
acceptance_criteria.when: the IoT device sends an update
acceptance_criteria.then: the map in my app reflects this change within 2 seconds.

edge_cases: The map layout does not match the physical layout of the laundromat.
The app fails to receive real-time updates due to poor connectivity on my device.

i_want: to receive a push notification when my laundry cycle is complete
so_that: I can leave the laundromat and return at the right time.

acceptance_criteria.given: I have started a laundry cycle and have notifications enabled
acceptance_criteria.when: the machine signals the end of its cycle
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive a push notification on my device that says 'Your laundry is done at Machine W-07' (or similar).

edge_cases: I have disabled push notifications for the app.
The notification is delayed due to mobile network issues.
I used guest checkout and am not eligible for push notifications.

i_want: to receive a reminder if I haven't collected my laundry shortly after it's finished
so_that: I don't forget it and can free up the machine for others.

acceptance_criteria.given: my laundry cycle finished 5 minutes ago and I have not opened the machine door
acceptance_criteria.when: the system checks for unattended laundry
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive a reminder push notification.

acceptance_criteria.given: my laundry cycle finished 3 minutes ago
acceptance_criteria.when: I open the machine door to collect my items
acceptance_criteria.then: I do not receive a reminder notification.

edge_cases: The machine's door sensor fails to register that the door was opened.

i_want: to create an account using my email, Google, or Apple ID
so_that: I can access features like loyalty points, subscriptions, and my transaction history.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am a new user
acceptance_criteria.when: I choose to sign up with my email and a password
acceptance_criteria.then: a new SpinCycle account is created for me.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am a new user
acceptance_criteria.when: I choose to sign up with my Google account and complete the Google auth flow
acceptance_criteria.then: a new SpinCycle account linked to my Google ID is created.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am a new user on an iOS device
acceptance_criteria.when: I choose to sign up with my Apple ID and complete the Apple auth flow
acceptance_criteria.then: a new SpinCycle account linked to my Apple ID is created.

edge_cases: I try to register with an email address that is already in use.
I cancel the social login process halfway through.
The social login provider (Google/Apple) is temporarily unavailable.

i_want: to log in to my dashboard using two-factor authentication
so_that: my sensitive business and financial data is protected from unauthorized access.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am a registered dashboard user and have set up 2FA
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter my correct email and password on the login page
acceptance_criteria.then: I am prompted to enter a 6-digit code from my authenticator app.

acceptance_criteria.given: I have been prompted for my 2FA code
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter the correct, valid code
acceptance_criteria.then: I am successfully logged in and redirected to the dashboard.

edge_cases: I enter an incorrect or expired 2FA code.
I have lost access to my 2FA device and need to use a recovery code.
The initial setup of 2FA fails.

i_want: to assign roles (Manager, Attendant) to my staff for each location
so_that: they can only access the information and tools necessary for their jobs.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in as an 'Owner'
acceptance_criteria.when: I assign a staff member the 'Manager' role for 'Location A'
acceptance_criteria.then: that user can view all data, including revenue reports, for 'Location A' but not for 'Location B'.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in as an 'Owner'
acceptance_criteria.when: I assign a staff member the 'Attendant' role for 'Location A'
acceptance_criteria.then: that user can view the machine status map but cannot access any revenue or financial pages.

acceptance_criteria.given: a user with the 'Attendant' role is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: they attempt to navigate directly to the URL for the revenue dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: they are shown an 'Access Denied' error page.

edge_cases: I accidentally assign a user to the wrong location.
A manager tries to access data from a location they are not assigned to.
An owner tries to create a custom role (which is not supported).

i_want: to see a live dashboard of all my machines
so_that: I can monitor my floor's operational status and machine performance in real-time.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and viewing the dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: I look at the list or map of machines
acceptance_criteria.then: I can see each machine's current status (idle, running, out of order).

acceptance_criteria.given: a machine is in the 'running' state
acceptance_criteria.when: I view its details on the dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: I can see the remaining time in its cycle.

acceptance_criteria.given: I have a standard broadband connection
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to the dashboard page
acceptance_criteria.then: the initial data for all my machines loads in under 3 seconds.

edge_cases: The dashboard fails to load if one or more IoT devices are offline.
The displayed 'time remaining' is out of sync with the actual machine.

i_want: to view key revenue metrics on my dashboard
so_that: I can quickly assess the financial performance of my location.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged into the dashboard with the 'Manager' or 'Owner' role
acceptance_criteria.when: I view the main reporting section
acceptance_criteria.then: I can see widgets or reports displaying total revenue for today, yesterday, and the same day last week.

acceptance_criteria.given: the primary payment provider's API is slow
acceptance_criteria.when: I load the revenue dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: the data is still served quickly from the local payment ledger.

edge_cases: The definition of 'today' is not clear regarding the location's timezone.
Revenue data for 'same day last week' is not available for a new location.

i_want: to access an analytics page with visual reports
so_that: I can identify trends like my busiest hours and most profitable machines.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the revenue analytics page
acceptance_criteria.when: I view the peak hours report
acceptance_criteria.then: I see a heatmap showing revenue concentration by day of the week and hour of the day.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the revenue analytics page
acceptance_criteria.when: I select the 'Revenue per Machine' view for the last 30 days
acceptance_criteria.then: I see a bar chart ranking each machine by the total revenue it generated.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the revenue analytics page
acceptance_criteria.when: I view the main metrics
acceptance_criteria.then: I see the average machine turnaround time for the selected period.

edge_cases: The data visualizations are difficult to interpret on a mobile device.
The date range filtering for analytics is not working correctly.

i_want: to export my financial data to CSV files
so_that: I can share it with my accountant and use it in other software.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am viewing the daily transaction report
acceptance_criteria.when: I click the 'Export to CSV' button
acceptance_criteria.then: a CSV file containing a line item for each transaction from that day is downloaded.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am viewing the monthly summary report for a location
acceptance_criteria.when: I click 'Export to CSV'
acceptance_criteria.then: a CSV file is downloaded containing columns for gross revenue, platform fees, refunds, and net revenue for that month.

edge_cases: The exported CSV has formatting issues when opened in Excel.
The export fails for very large date ranges due to a timeout.

i_want: to see a high-level aggregate view of all my locations
so_that: I can monitor the overall health of my business without drilling into each location individually.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in as an 'Owner' of multiple locations
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to the aggregate dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: I see a summary card for each location showing its total revenue for the day.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the aggregate dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: I look at a location's summary card
acceptance_criteria.then: I see a count of machines currently in 'idle', 'running', and 'out of order' states.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the aggregate dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: I click on a specific location's summary
acceptance_criteria.then: I am taken to the detailed dashboard for that location.

edge_cases: A newly added location does not appear on the aggregate view immediately.
The aggregate revenue totals do not match the sum of the individual location reports.

i_want: to be alerted on my dashboard when a machine reports a fault
so_that: I can dispatch a technician quickly and minimize downtime.

acceptance_criteria.given: a washer's IoT device detects a drainage error and publishes a fault code
acceptance_criteria.when: the backend system processes this event
acceptance_criteria.then: a new maintenance alert is created and displayed prominently on the dashboard for that location.

acceptance_criteria.given: an active maintenance alert exists for Machine D-04
acceptance_criteria.when: I view the machine status map
acceptance_criteria.then: Machine D-04 is marked with a special fault indicator.

edge_cases: The system generates duplicate alerts for the same ongoing fault.
An alert is not cleared automatically after the fault condition is resolved.

i_want: to log maintenance activities and notes for a machine
so_that: we have a clear history of all repairs and can track ongoing issues.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in as an 'Attendant' and notice a dryer is making a loud noise
acceptance_criteria.when: I select that dryer in the dashboard, create a new maintenance log entry with the note 'Bad belt', and set its status to 'Under Repair'
acceptance_criteria.then: the machine's public status is changed to 'Out of Order' and the note is saved to its history.

acceptance_criteria.given: a manager is viewing the maintenance history for that dryer
acceptance_criteria.when: they review the log
acceptance_criteria.then: they can see my entry with the timestamp, my name, and the note.

edge_cases: Two staff members try to log a maintenance note for the same machine simultaneously.
A staff member forgets to change the machine's status back to 'Idle' after a repair is completed.

i_want: to earn loyalty points for my spending and redeem them for free washes
so_that: I feel rewarded for being a frequent customer.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am a registered user with an account
acceptance_criteria.when: I pay for a $4.50 wash cycle
acceptance_criteria.then: 4 loyalty points are added to my account balance.

acceptance_criteria.given: I have 120 loyalty points in my account
acceptance_criteria.when: I choose to start a standard wash and select the option to 'Redeem 100 points'
acceptance_criteria.then: the cycle starts without charging my payment method and my point balance is reduced to 20.

edge_cases: I try to redeem points for a premium, non-standard wash cycle.
A transaction is refunded, and the earned loyalty points need to be clawed back.

i_want: to subscribe to a monthly 'Spin Pass'
so_that: I can get unlimited standard washes for a fixed price and save money.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am a registered customer
acceptance_criteria.when: I subscribe to the Spin Pass for a specific location
acceptance_criteria.then: I am charged the monthly fee of $25.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am an active Spin Pass subscriber
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a standard wash cycle at my designated location
acceptance_criteria.then: the cost is shown as $0 and I can start it without a new charge.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am an active Spin Pass subscriber
acceptance_criteria.when: I select a premium 'sanitize' cycle that normally costs $8.00
acceptance_criteria.then: the cost is shown as $4.00 (a 50% discount).

edge_cases: I try to use my subscription benefits at a different location than the one I subscribed to.
My monthly subscription payment fails to renew.
The price of a 'standard wash' changes after I subscribe.

i_want: to send promotional push notifications to my customers
so_that: I can increase business during off-peak hours.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged into the owner dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to the promotions tool, type a message like 'Half-price dryers all day Thursday!', and send it to my 'Downtown' location
acceptance_criteria.then: all registered customers who have opted-in to notifications for the 'Downtown' location receive the push notification.

edge_cases: I accidentally send a promotion to the wrong location.
The message contains a typo and I need to retract or correct it.
A large number of customers have opted out of notifications, limiting the promotion's reach.

i_want: to request a refund from the app if a machine fails
so_that: I can easily report a problem and get my money back without having to find an attendant.

acceptance_criteria.given: a machine I paid for stopped mid-cycle
acceptance_criteria.when: I go to my transaction history, select that transaction, and tap 'Request Refund'
acceptance_criteria.then: my request is submitted and its status is shown as 'Pending Review'.

edge_cases: I try to request a refund for a transaction that was completed successfully days ago.
The app is offline and cannot submit the refund request.

i_want: to review, approve, or deny customer refund requests
so_that: I have full control over issuing refunds for my location.

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer has submitted a refund request and it appears in my dashboard queue
acceptance_criteria.when: I review the details and click 'Approve'
acceptance_criteria.then: the refund is processed via Stripe and the request's status is updated to 'Approved'.

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer has submitted a refund request
acceptance_criteria.when: I investigate and determine it is not valid and click 'Deny'
acceptance_criteria.then: no refund is issued and the request's status is updated to 'Denied'.

edge_cases: I approve a refund by mistake and need to undo it.
The Stripe API call to process the refund fails.

i_want: to join a virtual waitlist when all machines are busy
so_that: I can be notified when one is free and don't have to stand around waiting.

acceptance_criteria.given: all front-load washers are in use
acceptance_criteria.when: I tap the 'Notify Me' button for that machine type
acceptance_criteria.then: I am added to the waitlist.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am first in the waitlist and a front-load washer becomes available
acceptance_criteria.when: the system detects the machine is free
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive a push notification and have 5 minutes to start a cycle on that machine.

acceptance_criteria.given: I was notified that a machine is available but did not start a cycle within 5 minutes
acceptance_criteria.when: my 5-minute window expires
acceptance_criteria.then: the next person in the queue is notified, and I lose my spot.

edge_cases: I join the waitlist but then leave the laundromat and am no longer in range to use the machine.
Multiple machines of the same type become free simultaneously.
I cancel my spot on the waitlist.

i_want: the system to securely process payments and settle funds to my account
so_that: I can trust the platform with my revenue and get paid reliably.

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer completes a $10.00 transaction at my location
acceptance_criteria.when: the payment is processed by Stripe Connect
acceptance_criteria.then: a 7% platform fee ($0.70) is taken, and the remaining $9.30 is allocated to my connected Stripe account.

acceptance_criteria.given: funds have been settled to my Stripe Connect account
acceptance_criteria.when: the configured payout schedule is reached
acceptance_criteria.then: the funds are paid out to my business bank account on a two-day rolling basis.

edge_cases: A customer's payment is subject to a chargeback.
My connected Stripe account information is invalid or needs re-verification.
There is a delay in the payout from Stripe.

i_want: to use the application in either English or Spanish
so_that: I can comfortably use the service in my preferred language.

acceptance_criteria.given: my phone's operating system language is set to Spanish
acceptance_criteria.when: I open the SpinCycle app
acceptance_criteria.then: all text in the user interface is displayed in Spanish.

acceptance_criteria.given: my phone's operating system language is set to French
acceptance_criteria.when: I open the SpinCycle app
acceptance_criteria.then: the user interface defaults to English.

edge_cases: Some text remains untranslated or is poorly translated.
The layout breaks for longer Spanish words compared to their English counterparts.

i_want: the system to handle data retention and purging correctly
so_that: we comply with legal requirements and manage storage costs efficiently.

acceptance_criteria.given: a financial transaction record is 7 years and 1 day old
acceptance_criteria.when: I query the database
acceptance_criteria.then: the record still exists.

acceptance_criteria.given: raw IoT telemetry event data is 91 days old
acceptance_criteria.when: the daily data purge job runs
acceptance_criteria.then: that raw event data is deleted from the database.

acceptance_criteria.given: raw IoT data from 91 days ago has been purged
acceptance_criteria.when: an owner views trend analysis reports for that period
acceptance_criteria.then: the reports are still available, generated from the retained daily aggregate data.

edge_cases: The data purge job fails to run, causing excessive data accumulation.
A legal hold requires retaining specific data beyond the normal 7-year period.

i_want: the system to be performant, reliable, secure, and resilient
so_that: it provides a trustworthy and high-quality service to both customers and owners.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system is under normal operation
acceptance_criteria.when: we measure uptime over a calendar month
acceptance_criteria.then: the public-facing APIs achieve at least 99.9% availability.

acceptance_criteria.given: a laundromat's internet connection goes down
acceptance_criteria.when: an IoT device on a machine sends status updates via MQTT every 10 seconds
acceptance_criteria.then: the device buffers at least 4 hours of these events and replays them when connectivity is restored.

acceptance_criteria.given: a single user of the customer API
acceptance_criteria.when: they make more than 100 requests in a 60-second window
acceptance_criteria.then: their subsequent requests receive a '429 Too Many Requests' error.

acceptance_criteria.given: a performance test is run
acceptance_criteria.when: the API is subjected to a load of 500 concurrent users for a single location
acceptance_criteria.then: API response times do not degrade beyond established thresholds.

edge_cases: A large-scale DDoS attack targets the API.
An IoT device's buffer overflows during a prolonged internet outage.

i_want: the mobile app and PWA to be compliant with WCAG 2.1 AA standards
so_that: I can use the service effectively with assistive technologies like screen readers or high-contrast mode.

acceptance_criteria.given: I use a screen reader on my phone
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate through the app
acceptance_criteria.then: all interactive elements (buttons, links, form fields) are properly labeled and announced.

acceptance_criteria.given: I have low vision and enable high-contrast mode
acceptance_criteria.when: I view the machine map or any other screen
acceptance_criteria.then: the text and UI elements meet the minimum color contrast ratios defined by WCAG 2.1 AA.

edge_cases: A third-party component (like the payment form) is not fully accessible.
New features are released that have not yet been audited for accessibility compliance.

i_want: to optionally enable and configure an idle fee for a location
so_that: I can incentivize customers to collect their laundry promptly, increasing machine turnover during busy periods.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am in my location's settings page on the dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: I enable the 'Idle Fee' toggle and set the rate to $0.25/min with a 15-minute grace period
acceptance_criteria.then: the idle fee system is activated for that location with my specified settings.

acceptance_criteria.given: the idle fee is enabled and a customer's cycle has been finished for 16 minutes and 30 seconds
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer opens the machine door
acceptance_criteria.then: the system charges them for 2 full minutes of idle time, totaling $0.50.

acceptance_criteria.given: I have disabled the 'Idle Fee' toggle for a location
acceptance_criteria.when: a customer leaves their laundry for 30 minutes after a cycle ends
acceptance_criteria.then: they are not charged any idle fee.

edge_cases: A customer is not clearly notified about the idle fee policy before starting their machine.
The door sensor reports an open event incorrectly, stopping the idle fee calculation prematurely.

i_want: to create a reservation for multiple machines in a single operation
so_that: I can efficiently block out time for my corporate clients who need guaranteed availability.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the reservations page of the dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: I select three specific washers, a date, and a time window of 6 AM to 8 AM, and confirm the reservation
acceptance_criteria.then: a single reservation is created that blocks all three machines for that period.

acceptance_criteria.given: a reservation exists for washer W-01 from 6 AM to 8 AM
acceptance_criteria.when: a regular customer views the machine map at 7 AM
acceptance_criteria.then: washer W-01 is shown as unavailable or reserved.

acceptance_criteria.given: a reservation exists with a start time of 6 AM
acceptance_criteria.when: I cancel the reservation at 4:01 AM (less than 2 hours before)
acceptance_criteria.then: a 50% cancellation fee is charged to the client's account on file.

edge_cases: I try to reserve a machine that is already part of another reservation at the same time.
A regular customer starts a long cycle that overlaps with the beginning of a reservation window.
The basis for calculating the 'reservation cost' (for the cancellation fee) is not defined.
